procedure.method: Fresh independent session; no spawn, fork, resume or peer review. Read the exact pinned case, packet, rules, rubric and compact instructions. Verified their pins and the five pinned native-evidence manifests, reading those manifests without following embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so the two source receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Used functions.exec with tools.view_image(detail="original") and emitted each exact PNG, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in the same three-view order. All fifteen actual images were displayed and visually inspected before beginning any copy-reading/transcription or judgment. After this complete pass, first readings were made from the retained native displays, with layout and usage-size fitness assessed separately against the completed use/thumbnail displays. No glyph ambiguity required a revisit. File verification and manifest fields were not used as claims of semantic viewing. No source pixels, tool event, timestamp or runtime session ID is invented.
